snippet.title: Assassin's Creed Liberation HD: Justice For All Trailer
snippet.description:
As Templars secretly take hold of the slave trade in New Orleans, Aveline de Grandpré, an assassin of mixed French and African heritage, stands ready to defend her people. She soon finds herself on an unforgettable journey that will take her from the crowded streets of New Orleans to voodoo-haunted swamps and ancient Mayan ruins.      

Rated Mature: intense violence, blood, suggestive themes, language and crude humor.
